requirement: Apply takes off the template pages of kinds the customer did not pick, never home or contact, with a products/services stand-in and system menus safe

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: Ledger L04, 05/10/2026: a customer who picked only Home, Product, About and Contact still got Services, News and Projects published, and picking Pricing made no page: Apply turned the `pages` answer into a line of text. Reds 4a2262563, 2c81f358e, 3e2ecdbe6, 20affbbc3, 392cd54ac; fixes e6f510e5d, ef27d0272, fdf0a92e4, b81925f84, 70a25320c.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 124). Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): a page is a kind only when every word of its address names that one kind; pages of unpicked kinds go (WordPress: drafted with the sweep, its slots not planned; Joomla: its menu entries and the ones under them unpublished in transactions of at most 100), home and contact never, Services stands in for picked Products and the reverse, a missing picked kind is noted only when every page could be read, no `pages` answer changes nothing, and a system-menu entry, the home entry or an unreadable menu is never unpublished.
